description: Homelab Ansible automation: LiteLLM, Langfuse, K3s, Windows/macOS hosts, agent runtime plans. Prefer roles/playbooks over ad-hoc scripts.
rules: Ansible-first: prefer roles with present|absent and playbooks over ad-hoc SSH.
NetBox is source of truth for host/VM/IP identity when modeling.
LiteLLM gateway is litellm.hom.lab; do not point clients at raw vLLM ports for normal work.
LangGraph is the selected agent application runtime; Google ADK is not primary.
Use bin/codex-env for repo-local Python/Ansible/WinRM-sensitive commands.
Never commit or request vault secrets into Context7 queries.
